scenes.narration: Meet EdulabsAI: one connected teaching workspace from the first idea to the next better lesson.
Start with a curriculum, grade, subject and topic. Add your own source when exact local grounding matters.
Generate a coherent lesson plan, visual slides, quiz and worksheet together, from the same objective.
Edit with AI, make teacher changes, preview clearly, then export the resources you choose.
Teach live with whole-class and group chat, teacher moderation, and an assessment focus lock when students need it.
Bring paper answers back through Snap and Mark, with de-identified recognition and an explicit teacher review.
When a pattern repeats, turn the verified misconception into editable groups and a ready Tomorrow Pack.
Then share a consent-first Family Digest only after the teacher approves the useful learning summary.
Plan once. Teach live. Respond with evidence. Start free at edulabsai dot com.
